detections.description: A woman fires a handgun multiple times in a corridor; muzzle flash and smoke are visible at frames f4–f7, with debris and dust kicked up by impacts.
After the initial shooting, a person lies motionless on the floor (visible in f7–f8, f10), while the woman continues to aim and move through the space, indicating an attack on a helpless victim.
A woman fires a handgun at close range; visible muzzle flash and smoke emanate from the barrel in frame f2.
Two men engage in close-quarters physical confrontation: one raises his hand aggressively while the other leans in, suggesting grappling or striking; visible in frames f7–f8.
The woman aims and fires her handgun again; clear muzzle flash and forward recoil visible in frame f8 (simultaneous with fighting event).
The woman fires her handgun a third time; distinct muzzle flash and smoke visible in frame f10.
A firearm is discharged; visible muzzle flash and smoke emanate from the weapon held by a figure on the right in frame f5, with recoil and smoke persisting into f6.
A woman and a man engage in close-quarters physical struggle; the woman grabs the man's arm while he leans in, indicating mutual combat.
The man forcefully grips the woman’s neck/chin area while she grimaces in pain (f8–f9), indicating an attack on a vulnerable position before the shooting.
A woman is engaged in close-quarters physical struggle with an assailant; she appears to be resisting, with her arms raised and body tensed, while the assailant grips her.
A firearm is discharged: visible muzzle flash and recoil at 17.0s (f10), with the gun pointed toward the woman who is recoiling; smoke/flash persists through f11.

A person lies motionless on the floor while another stands over them holding a weapon; later frames show a second person on the ground struggling, suggesting ongoing coercion or assault of helpless individuals.; A man is on the ground, visibly injured and struggling, while a woman stands over him holding a firearm; his posture and facial expression indicate he is helpless and being threatened or attacked.
A muzzle flash is visible from a firearm held by a standing figure, indicating a shot was fired.

The woman raises a handgun and aims it directly forward; muzzle flash or recoil is not visible, but the framing and her intent posture strongly suggest an imminent or just-executed shot in this narrow window.
